observer.elevation: Parcel origin, mean of the parcel vertices. Not a surveyed monument. Elevation treated as zero.

calculation.method: Geometric solar position from the NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory spreadsheet equations, based on Jean Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms.
calculation.refraction: Not applied. The NOAA solar-position page models atmospheric refraction separately. This study uses the airless geometric elevation.
calculation.not: This calculation does not call NOAA or JPL, and it is not the low-accuracy fractional-year formula in https://gml.noaa.gov/grad/solcalc/solareqns.PDF.

horizons.role: Independent check. Not an input to the study.
horizons.agreement: The checked samples stay within about 0.02 degrees. The study numbers were not replaced with the Horizons numbers.
